text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Eishin Flash playing a card game
with her friends in the classroom.

text_block_list.name: Card-Savvy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I win~! Man, that was close.
If you'd been two moves faster, I would've lost♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...With as many as 52 cards,
it gets quite confusing.

text_block_list.name: Card-Savvy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, does Germany
have a different number of cards in a deck?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. However, the difference in the number of cards doesn't matter.
My own mistake was the reason for my defeat. I will definitely win next time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... J-Just one more match! Just a little more,
just a little more and I should have you completely read...!

Perhaps she kept losing after that,
because Eishin Flash remained in a bad mood
for quite a while.
